@graph.name: Palletizer ROI Calculator | TRF Industrial Automation
@graph.description: Palletizer ROI calculator: estimate the payback of a robotic palletizer from your shifts, labor, state labor rates and investment.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Typical Payback Period for a Robotic Palletizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single typical figure. Payback depends on the labor hours the palletizer replaces, shifts per day, local labor cost and the cost of the system you buy. The calculator applies the method on this page to your inputs, and a TRF Sales Engineer completes the estimate with the installed scope of your project.

mainEntity.name: Where Does the Reference Labor Rate Come From?

acceptedAnswer.text: The reference hourly rate for each state is a production wage from public U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data, a base wage without payroll costs. It fills in when you select your state, and you can edit it at any time. Use your own loaded rate, including benefits, when you present the estimate to finance.

mainEntity.name: Is the Calculator Result a Quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The result is an initial planning estimate built from your inputs and reference data. Your final price and payback come from a quote, which a TRF Sales Engineer prepares after validating the platform, tooling, pallet patterns, conveyors, installation and integration for your line.

mainEntity.name: Can I Use This Calculator for a Case Packer?

acceptedAnswer.text: The calculator is built for palletizing, and its platform list covers TRFCobot, TRFCompact and TRFSpeed. The labor logic is similar for case packing: the manual labor removed, compared with the cost of the system. For TRFRapidpack, TRFOnepack or TRFDroppack, talk with a TRF Sales Engineer about your products and rates on the case packing page.

mainEntity.name: Why Does the Calculator Ask for a Work Email?

acceptedAnswer.text: The preview appears as you type. The work email unlocks the full breakdown and lets TRF follow up with a Sales Engineer who starts from your numbers instead of a blank page. Personal email domains are not accepted. TRF uses your email and inputs to send the estimate and follow up about your project, as described in the Privacy Policy.
